text:
liz: Heads-up — change window tomorrow 09:00-13:00 PT. Launch freeze starts 08:30 PT. Using this thread for readiness checks, canary/rollback plan, and release notes sync. @deploy-bot will kick off canaries at 09:15.

aj: Noted. Which services are in-scope for the window?

liz: Scope: runtime-api (pin to v2.3.1), batch-encoder, and the Redis cache config (TTL change). We'll postpone heavy infra changes.

jason: Can we postpone the cache TTL change until after the launch? That one feels risky for canary.

maria: +1 to @jason. If it's safe to push cache TTL out, let's do it.

liz: OK — cache TTL change moved to post-launch. Canary plan: 10% -> 50% after 15m if no alerts -> 100% after additional 15m. Rollback window: maintain ability to rollback within first 30 minutes of each promotion.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy starting: runtime-api v2.3.1 -> prod-canary1 (10% traffic). started at 09:15:22 PT

sre-oncall: Dashboards prepped, alert thresholds set (latency p95 > 600ms for 3m, error rate > 1% for 2m). I bumped CPU alert to 70% for 2m for the canary ramp.

aj: I'll run smoke tests right after canary is up. Queueing: 'make smoke' then quick health check.

aj: ```bash
# smoke test snippet
make smoke || exit 1
curl -sS https://prod.internal/health | jq .status
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary healthy at 09:22. Promoting to 50% traffic.

liz: Reminder: freeze = no infra or schema changes except emergency rollback. All non-urgent PRs paused. Put any emergency exceptions here with owner and reason.

liz: Rollback procedure (documented):
```
# rollback steps (runtime-api)
1) deploy-bot: promote previous revision: `deploy-bot promote runtime-api v2.3.0 --to prod`
2) Notify #incidents and paging oncall (sre-oncall).
3) Revert infra flags if applicable (feature flags -> off).
4) Create hotfix PR and tag `release/rollback` for post-mortem.
Approvals required: one service owner + oncall ack.
```

maria: Who signs off the immediate rollback? @liz + @sre-oncall?

liz: Yes — one owner (me for runtime-api) + oncall. If it's a cross-service/major incident, escalate to Eng CT and PM.

jason: I'll watch latency dashboards and prepare comparison graphs (canary vs baseline).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion complete at 09:33. runtime-api now at 100% on v2.3.1

sre-oncall: Alerts stable so far, no action. Monitoring through the rest of the morning.

liz: :rocket: Launch freeze partially lifted at 10:00 PT for docs and marketing updates only. No infra changes until EOD unless emergency. Keep monitoring until 18:00 PT.

aj: Thanks everyone. Drafted release notes and checklist here: https://confluence.redwood/release/2026-03-runtime-api-v2-3-1 (please add any post-launch items).

jason: thumbs up. Will post graphs in #eng-releases later if anything looks off.

maria: Good run, nice catch on deferring the cache TTL.

liz: Excellent work team — filing post-launch follow-up and postmortem template if needed.
